suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 is unsafe deserialization in the Kotlin *build cache metadata*, i.e. the Kotlin compiler / Gradle build tooling (fixed in Kotlin 2.4.20). Dependency-Check matches it by the broad CPE "jetbrains:kotlin" to the runtime kotlin-stdlib jars, which contain no build cache code. Not reachable in the APK. Revisit when the toolchain moves to Kotlin >= 2.4.20.

CVE-2024-7254 (protobuf-javalite 3.21.8) is detected inside compose-ui's inspector.jar, the Android Studio Layout Inspector agent bundled in the AAR. Inspector jars are consumed by the IDE and are not packaged into the APK; the app does not parse protobuf data.
